article.headline: Carroll’s 19 lead Fort Valley State over Florida A&M 75-70
article.description: — Inslee Carroll’s 19 points helped Fort Valley State defeat Florida A&M 75-70 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Carroll’s 19 lead Fort Valley State over Florida A&M 75-70

categories.description: Fort Valley State Wildcats @ Florida A&M Rattlers

event.description: Fort Valley State Wildcats @ Florida A&M Rattlers

keywords: Fort Valley State Wildcats @ Florida A&M Rattlers
article.story: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. ( -- — Inslee Carroll’s 19 points helped Fort Valley State defeat Florida A&M 75-70 on Thursday. Carroll also contributed three steals for the Wildcats. Katayvon Jefferies finished 5 of 12 from 3-point range to add 15 points. Kaleel Stillman shot 3 for 8 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Daisean Williford finished with 22 points for the Rattlers (0-2). Florida A&M also got 21 points and seven rebounds from Jaden Kempson. Ben Ndour also had seven points and six rebounds. Up next Florida A&M visits UAB in its next matchup on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
